entities.summary: The University Library Svetozar Marković (Serbian: Универзитетска библиотека Светозар Марковић, romanized: Univerzitetska biblioteka Svetozar Marković) is the main library in the University of Belgrade system, named after Svetozar Marković, a Serbian political activist in the 19th century. It is located on King Alexander Boulevard, close to the Faculty of Law and adjacent to the Faculties of Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Architecture. Serves the educational and scientific needs of students, academics, and scientists.
